additions.group: 極小・周期検出・確率的時系列予測
additions.reason_selected: Preserve original compact attention-free learned quantile forecasting using computed periodicity and tied convolutional network; ~35x fewer parameters than selected Timestral-5M, separate low-resource research operating point. Not a quantization of incumbent; no evidence to replace multivariate/covariate forecasters.
additions.quality_positive: Publisher GIFT-Eval 97 configs nGMASE 0.7738, nWQL/CRPS column 0.5454, nMSIS 0.5541 with BF16 autocast, flip symmetry and period alignment; 146505 unique F32 parameters, attention-free spectral period detection and dilated causal convolution. Paper reports Cortex-M7 INT8 4.08 s, 731 KB RAM; hardware clock/batch and independent replay not verified here.
additions.quality_negative: TinyCast nGMASE 0.7738 worse than separate Timestral-5M 0.705, Toto-2.0-4m 0.757, Hirondel 0.7003; these are not matched comparisons. Univariate, 2048 context, nine quantiles; default inference does not reproduce table; training distributed launcher absent, no matched host/MCU ABI, clock, RAM or independent evaluation. No claim of superiority.
additions.risk_and_alternative_assessment: Lawful local sensor/energy forecasting and calibration; privacy/rights and operational use validation separate; no harmful or bypass ranking. KEEP incumbent; no replacement evidence.
additions.observed_access: public ungated as observed during 2026-11-28 research
